description:
WRITE - cancels a PENDING Zircuit Finance withdraw request (Q402 Yield on base, USDC). Zircuit withdrawals are queued: q402_yield_withdraw files a request that pays out later (usually within 24 hours, up to 14 days). While it is still pending, this cancels it and the queued shares go back into the wallet's Zircuit position; no USDC is paid out. A request that was already processed or canceled can't be canceled (the server says which). Find request ids in q402_yield_positions (pendingWithdrawals) or in q402_yield_withdraw's result. Server-managed Agent Wallet path (Mode C): authenticated by the configured live Multichain API key. 

REQUIRES CONFIRMATION - call FIRST without confirm to get a preview and a consentToken, show it to the user, get explicit approval, THEN re-call with confirm:true AND the consentToken. 

SANDBOX BY DEFAULT - nothing happens on-chain unless a live Multichain key (q402_live_*) is configured AND Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS=1.

chain.description: Chain of the request. Zircuit withdraw requests live on 'base'.

confirm.description: MUST be true to actually cancel - only after the user approved canceling this exact request.

consentToken.description: Two-phase consent token from the preview call. Bound to (chain, requestId, wallet).

requestId.description: The pending withdraw request id (digits, no leading zeros), from q402_yield_positions pendingWithdrawals or the withdraw result.

walletId.description: Optional Agent Wallet address that filed the request. Defaults to Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS, then the owner's default wallet.

name: q402_yield_cancel
